faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Hive ecosystem.
faq.q1: Does Hive ERP work during internet outages?
faq.a1: Yes. Our mobile apps and POS systems feature offline-sync. They store data locally and automatically push to the central cloud once connection is restored.
faq.q2: Is our corporate data stored locally in Ethiopia?
faq.a2: We offer hybrid deployments. You can choose to host your Node on our secure AWS infrastructure, or deploy an On-Premise instance directly within your local data center for strict INSA compliance.
faq.q3: Can we integrate existing legacy software?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Hive comes with a comprehensive REST API and webhooks, allowing Techive Technology Solutions to build custom bridges to your existing software.
faq.q4: How does the multi-tenant architecture work?
faq.a4: Each company gets its own isolated database schema. This guarantees zero data-bleed between clients while allowing us to push instantaneous system updates to everyone simultaneously.
